subject: Transitional credit request for on‑prem network delay
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Priyanka Sharma <psharma@acme-payments.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 29 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Transitional credit request for on‑prem network delay

Hi Priyanka —

Thanks again for the detailed log you shared yesterday. We dug through the on‑prem connectivity traces and confirmed the root cause is a vendor NAT configuration that landed later than both teams anticipated. I know this has impacted your integration timeline for the private deployment pilot and will push your launch beyond the agreed milestone.

Given the delay, we’d like to propose a one‑month transitional credit to help cover the incremental infra and customer comms cost while you finish the network changes. Proposal (high level):
- One month of credits equivalent to $25,000 applied to ACME account on next invoice
- Credit tied to the delayed pilot milestone (not future usage)
- Legal to sign a short addendum to the SOW (I attached a redline)

Can you confirm this would be acceptable to your team as a temporary remedy while the network vendor finishes the fix? If yes, we’ll route for an internal exec approval and share the addendum + amended commercial summary.

Attachments: SOW_redlined_v2.pdf (redlines), commercial-summary.xlsx (pricing impact draft)

—Jordan
Jordan Blake
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
jordan.blake@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0198

From: Priyanka Sharma <psharma@acme-payments.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 30 May 2027 08:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Transitional credit request for on‑prem network delay

Jordan —

Appreciate the quick proposal and for pulling the redline together. The ask looks reasonable from our side; our PMs would prefer the credit be applied to the pilot invoice rather than a future invoice if possible. A couple of clarifying Qs:
1) Term: is the credit one‑time or is it structured to cover recurring fees if the delay extends?
2) Signoff: what internal approvals do you need and how long will that take? We have a go/no‑go with our launch committee on June 8 and would love confirmation before then.

If you can get an internal OK by EOD Monday we can hold the committee decision pending paperwork.

Thanks —
Priyanka Sharma
Head of Integrations, Acme Payments
psharma@acme-payments.com | +1 212-555-0122

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 31 May 2027 11:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Transitional credit request for on‑prem network delay

Team —

Looping in commercial and finance. Summary from Jordan/Acme: vendor‑caused network NAT misconfiguration pushed pilot launch out; Acme is requesting a one‑month transitional credit (~$25k) applied to the pilot invoice. Priyanka asked for confirmation before their June 8 launch committee.

Operational asks:
- Karthik: please confirm legal/finance signoff path and whether we can do a short addendum (one page) vs a full SOW amendment. Need expected SLA for a final counter‑signed doc.
- Marcus: please provide a quick impact calc (revenue recognition and GAAP treatment) and confirm we can absorb $25k without exceeding our monthly concession budget for May/June.
- Marissa: if this is escalated to execs, please prep the one‑pager for CEO/CFO that explains customer impact, strategic value, and expected churn risk.

Priyanka — tentatively we can route for a one‑time credit applied to the pilot invoice. Need internal approvals today/tomorrow. Jordan will coordinate and come back with exact wording and a signed addendum if approved.

Laura Bennett
VP, Commercial Operations | Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwood.com

From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Priyanka Sharma <psharma@acme-payments.com>
Date: Mon, 31 May 2027 15:42:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Transitional credit request for on‑prem network delay

Quick update —

Marissa just confirmed a verbal OK from CFO (Brad) for a one‑time credit of $25,000 to be applied to the pilot invoice. Karthik/legal indicated we can do a one‑page addendum; Marcus validated the budget impact and confirmed it fits the concession bucket for May.

Next steps:
- I’ll send the addendum to Priyanka for signature (SOW_redlined_v2.pdf attached).
- Finance will apply the $25k as a line item credit to the pilot invoice once signed.
- Laura/Marissa: please approve final wording below for exec brief (copy for CFO):

---draft wording---
Redwood agrees to provide Acme Payments a one‑time transitional commercial credit in the gross amount of $25,000 USD to be applied to the pilot deployment invoice to compensate for delays caused by an on‑prem network vendor configuration issue. The credit is a goodwill accommodation and is not an admission of liability. The credit will be applied upon execution of a mutually agreed addendum to the SOW.
---end draft---

Priyanka — if that wording looks good we’ll route for signatures today and confirm before your June 8 committee.

Thanks —
Jordan

Attachments: commercial-summary.xlsx
